entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னறி, முன்னேகுறி

to have knowledge of beforehand; to foreknow
entries.english: From G4253 and G1097; to know beforehand, that is, foresee: - foreknow (ordain), know (before).

entries.tamil:
முன்னறிவு - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. foreknowledge
2. forethought, pre - arrangement
entries.english: From G4267; forethought: - foreknowledge.

entries.tamil:
பெற்றோர், முன்னோர் - பெயரடை

born before, older
entries.english: From G4266; an ancestor, (grand-) parent: - forefather, parent.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்பு எழுதியிரு, பூர்வத்திலே எழுதியிரு. முன் வெளிப்படுத்து

1. to write before
2. to depict or portray openly
entries.english: From G4253 and G1125; to write previously; figuratively to announce, prescribe: - before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime).

entries.tamil:
வெளியரங்கமான, பிரசித்தமான - பெயரடை

openly evident, known to all, manifest
entries.english: From G4253 and G1212; plain before all men, that is, obvious: - evident, manifest (open) beforehand.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முந்திக்கொடு

1. to give before, give first
2. to betray
entries.english: From G4253 and G1325; to give before the other party has given: - first give.

entries.tamil:
துரோகி - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a betrayer, traitor
entries.english: From G4272 (in the sense of giving forward into another’s [the enemy’s] hands); a surrender: - betrayer, traitor.

entries.tamil:
முன்னோடி - பெயரடை

a forerunner
entries.english: From the alternate of G4390; a runner ahead, that is, scout (figuratively precursor): - forerunner.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னமாக காண்

to foresee
entries.english: From G4253 and G1492; foresee: - foresee, saw before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சுதந்தரமாகு

to hope before
entries.english: From G4253 and G1679; to hope in advance of other confirmation: - first trust.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னறிவி, முன்னே சொல்

to say beforehand; to warn in advance to predict
entries.english: From G4253 and G2036; to say already, to predict: - forewarn, say (speak, tell) before. Compare G4280.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - தொடங்கு, ஆரம்பம் பண்ணு

to make a beginning before
entries.english: From G4253 and G1728; to commence already: - begin (before).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - வாக்குத்தத்தம் பண்ணு

to announce before
entries.english: Middle voice from G4253 and G1861; to promise of old: - promise before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னறிவி, முன்னே சொல்

to say already, predict
entries.english: From G4253 and G2046; used as alternate of G4277; to say already, predict: - foretell, say (speak, tell) before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - அப்புறம் போ, முன்னே நட, முன்னாக போ, முன்னதாக அனுப்பு

1. to go forward, go on
2. to go before
entries.english: From G4253 and G2064 (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time): - go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - எத்தனமாக்கு, ஆயத்தப்படுத்து

to prepare before, to make ready beforehand:
entries.english: From G4253 and G2090; to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively): - ordain before, prepare afore.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னறிவி

to announce or promise glad tidings beforehand
entries.english: Middle voice from G4253 and G2097; to announce glad news in advance: - preach before the gospel.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - விசேஷித்தவர்களாயிரு

to have before or in advance of another, to have pre - eminence over another, to excel, to surpass
entries.english: Middle voice from G4253 and G2192; to hold oneself before others, that is, (figuratively) to excel: - be better.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முந்திக்கொள்

to go before and show the way, to go before and lead, to go before as leader
entries.english: From G4253 and G2233; to lead the way for others, that is, show deference: - prefer.

entries.tamil:
பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல் - மனநிர்ணயம், கோருதல், தீர்மானம், தெரிந்து கொள்ளுதல், நோக்கம்

1. the setting forth of a thing
2. a purpose
entries.english: From G4388; a setting forth, that is, (figuratively) proposal (intention); specifically the show bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God: - purpose, shew [-bread].

entries.tamil:
குறித்த காலமான - பெயரடை

set beforehand, appointed determined beforehand, pre - arranged
entries.english: From G4253 and a derivative of G5087; fixed beforehand, that is, (feminine with G2250 implied) a designated day: - time appointed.

entries.tamil:
மனோவாஞ்சை, மனவிருப்பம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. zeal, spirit, eagerness
2. inclination: readiness of mind
entries.english: From G4289; predisposition, that is, alacrity: - forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.

entries.tamil:
உற்சாகமுள்ள, விருப்பமான - பெயரடை

ready, willing
entries.english: From G4253 and G2372; forward in spirit, that is, predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity: - ready, willing.

entries.tamil:
உற்சாகமாய் - வினையடை

willingly, with alacrity
entries.english: Adverb from G4289; with alacrity: - willingly.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முதலாளியாயிரு, நடத்து, விசாரணைசெய்

1. to set place before; to set over
2. to be over, to superintend preside over
3. to be a protector or guardian; to give aid
4. to care for, give attention to
entries.english: From G4253 and G2476; to stand before, that is, (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise: - maintain, be over, rule.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கோபமூட்டு

to call forth
entries.english: Middle voice from G4253 and G2564; to call forth to oneself (challenge), that is, (by implication) to irritate: - provoke.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னறிவி, முன்னதாக அனுப்பு

to announce beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G2605; to announce beforehand, that is, predict, promise: - foretell, have notice (shew) before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னதாக அனுப்பு

to prepare, make up, beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G2675; to prepare in advance: - make up beforehand.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மன விருப்பமாயிரு, முன்வை, நியமித்திரு

1. to lie or be placed before
2. to be set before,
entries.english: From G4253 and G2749; to lie before the view, that is, (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward): - be first, set before (forth).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னேகுறி

1. to announce or proclaim by herald beforehand
2. to announce beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G2784; to herald (that is, proclaim) in advance: - before (first) preach.

entries.tamil:
பிரபலமாகுதல், பெருகுதல், விளங்குதல் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

progress, advancement
entries.english: From G4298; progress, that is, advancement (subjectively or objectively): - furtherance, profit.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - விருத்தியடை, தேறு, பலப்படு

1. to lengthen out by hammering
2. to go forward, advance, proceed
entries.english: From G4253 and G2875; to drive forward (as if by beating), that is, (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along): - increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.

entries.tamil:
பட்சபாதம் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

an opinion formed before the facts are known a prejudgment, a prejudice,
entries.english: From a compound of G4253 and G2919; a prejudgment (prejudice), that is, prepossession: - prefer one before another.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உறுதிபண்ணு

to sanction, ratify, or establish beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G2964; to ratify previously: - confirm before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முந்திக்கொள்

1. to take before
2. to anticipate, to forestall
3. to take one by forestalling
entries.english: From G4253 and G2983; to take in advance, that is, (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise: - come aforehand, overtake, take before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னறிவி, முன்னே சொல்

to say beforehand, to predict
entries.english: From G4253 and G3004; to say beforehand, that is, predict, forewarn: - foretell, tell before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னறிவி

1. antetestor
2. to testify beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G3143; to be a witness in advance, that is, predict: - testify beforehand.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நிர்ணயம் பண்ணிக்கொள்

to meditate beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G3191; to premeditate: - meditate before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னதாகக் கவலைப்படு

to be anxious beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G3309; to care (anxiously) in advance: - take thought beforehand.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நாடு, விசாரி

1. to perceive before, foresee
2. to provide, think of beforehand
entries.english: From G4253 and G3539; to consider in advance, that is, look out for beforehand (active voice by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself): - provide (for).

entries.tamil:
பராமரிப்பு, பேணுதல் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

forethought, provident care
entries.english: From G4306; forethought, that is, provident care or supply: - providence, provision.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னமாக அறி

1. to see before
2. to keep before one's eyes, to be mindful of one always
entries.english: From G4253 and G3708; to behold in advance, that is, (active voice) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one’s own) view: - foresee, see before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்குறித்திரு, ஏற்படுத்து

predetermine, predestinate
entries.english: From G4253 and G3724; to limit in advance, that is, (figuratively) predetermine: - determine before, ordain, predestinate.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னமே சஞ்சலப்படு

to suffer before
entries.english: From G4253 and G3958; to undergo hardship previously: - suffer before.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - வழிவிட்டனுப்பு, கூடப்போ

1. to send before
2. to send forward, bring on the way, accompany or escort
entries.english: From G4253 and G3992; to send forward, that is, escort or aid in travel: - accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.

entries.tamil:
பதறிச்செய்கிற, துணிகரமுள்ள - பெயரடை

1. falling forward, headlong, sloping, precipitous
2. precipitate, rash, reckless
entries.english: From a compound of G4253 and G4098; falling forward, that is, headlong (figuratively precipitate): - heady, rash [-ly].

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முன்னாகநட, முன்செல்

to send before, to make to precede
entries.english: From G4253 and G4198; to precede (as guide or herald): - go before.

entries.tamil:
இல், நிமித்தம் - முன்னிடைச்சொல்

to, toward
entries.english: A strengthened form of G4253; a preposition of direction; forward to, that is, toward (with the genitive case the side of, that is, pertaining to; with the dative case by the side of, that is, near to; usually with the accusative case the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, that is, whither or for which it is predicated): - about, according to, against, among, at, because of, before, between, ([where-]) by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), + together, to ([you]) -ward, unto, with (-in). In compounds it denotes essentially the same applications, namely, motion towards, accession to, or nearness at.

entries.tamil:
ஓய்வு நாளுக்கு முந்தின நாள் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

the day before the sabbath
entries.english: From G4253 and G4521; a fore sabbath, that is, the sabbath eve: - day before the sabbath. Compare G3904.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஒப்புவி

to speak to, to address, accost, salute
entries.english: From G4314 and a derivative of G58 (meaning to harangue); to address, that is, salute by name: - call.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கொண்டுவா, சேர், கிட்டிவா

1. to lead to, bring
2. to draw near to, approach
entries.english: From G4314 and G71; to lead towards, that is, (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach: - bring, draw near,

entries.tamil:
அடைதல், சேர்தல் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. the act of bringing to, a moving to
2. access, approach
entries.english: From G4317 (compare G72); admission: - access.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பிச்சைகேள்

1. to ask for in addition
2. to approach one with supplications
entries.english: From G4314 and G154; to ask repeatedly (importune), that is, solicit: - beg.

entries.tamil:
உயர்ந்த இடத்திற்குப்போ - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

to go up farther
entries.english: From G4314 and G305; to ascend farther, that is, be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat): - go up.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - செலவழி

to expend further, spend
entries.english: From G4314 and G355; to expend further: - spend.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - குறைகளை நீக்கு, குறைகளை நிறைவாக்கு

to fill up by adding to, to supply
entries.english: From G4314 and G378; to fill up further, that is, furnish fully: - supply.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - யோசனை பண்ணு, போதி

1. to lay upon in addition
2. to add from one's store
entries.english: From G4314 and G394; to lay up in addition, that is, (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult: - in conference add, confer.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பயமுறுத்து

to add threats, threaten further
entries.english: From G4314 and G546; to menace additionally: - threaten further.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - செலவழி

to spend besides
entries.english: From G4314 and G1159; to expend additionally: - spend more.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - தேவையாயிரு

to want besides, need in addition
entries.english: From G4314 and G1189; to require additionally, that is, want further: - need.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - காத்திரு, காத்துக்கொள், எதிர்பார், நம்பிக்கை கொள்

1. to receive to oneself, to admit, to give access to oneself
2. to expect
entries.english: From G4314 and G1209; to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence or (figuratively) endurance); by implication to await (with confidence or patience): - accept, allow, look (wait) for, take.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - காத்திரு, நினை, எண்ணு, எண்ணங்கொள், பார்

to expect
entries.english: From G4314 and δοκεύω dokeuō (to watch); to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication to await: - (be in) expect (-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for.

entries.tamil:
எதிர்பார்த்திருத்தல், எண்ணம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

expectation
entries.english: From G4328; apprehension (of evil); by implication infliction anticipated: - expectation, looking after.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உத்தரவுகொடு

to permit one to approach arrive
entries.english: From G4314 and G1439; to permit further progress: - suffer.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சமீபமாய் சேர்

to approach unto
entries.english: From G4314 and G1448; to approach near: - come nigh.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பணிவிடை

1. properly, to sit near
2. to attend assiduously
entries.english: From a compound of G4314 and the base of G1476; to sit near, that is, attend as a servant: - wait at.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஆதாயம் தேடு

1. to work besides
2. by working or trading to make or gain besides
entries.english: From G4314 and G2038; to work additionally, that is, (by implication) acquire besides: - gain.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்

to come to, to approach
entries.english: From G4314 and G2064 (including its alternate); to approach, that is, (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to: - (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto).

entries.tamil:
ஜெபம், விண்ணப்பம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. prayer addressed to God
2. a place set apart or suited for the offering of prayer
entries.english: From G4336; prayer (worship); by implication an oratory (chapel): - X pray earnestly, prayer.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஜெபம் பண்ணு, வேண்டிக்கொள், வேண்டுதல் செய்

to offer prayers, to pray
entries.english: From G4314 and G2172; to pray to God, that is, supplicate, worship: - pray (X earnestly, for), make prayer.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - எச்சரிக்கையாயிரு, கவனி, செவிகொடு, ஜாக்கிரதையாயிரு

to turn to, to bring to, bring near
entries.english: From G4314 and G2192; (figuratively) to hold the mind (G3563 implied) towards, that is, pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to: - (give) attend (-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to, unto) have regard.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஆணி அடி

to fasten with nails to, nail to
entries.english: From G4314 and a derivative of G2247; to peg to, that is, spike fast: - nail to.

entries.tamil:
வேறுமார்க்கத்தான், வேறு மார்க்கத்தமைந்தவன் - பெயரடை

1. a newcomer a stranger, alien
2. a proselyte
entries.english: From the alternate of G4334; an arriver from a foreign region, that is, (specifically) an acceder (convert) to Judaism (“proselyte”): - proselyte.

சேனை, போர்ச்சேவகர் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. an army
2. a band of soldiers
3. body - guard, guardsmen
entries.english: From G4754; an armament, that is, (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic): - army, soldier, man of war.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேவகம் பண்ணு, போர் செய், போராட்டம் பண்ணு

to make a military expedition, to lead soldiers to war or to battle, to fight
entries.english: Middle voice from the base of G4756; to serve in a military campaign; figuratively to execute the apostolate (with its arduous duties and functions), to contend with carnal inclinations: - soldier, (go to) war (-fare).

entries.tamil:
சேனைத் தலைவன், அதிகாரி - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. the commander of an army
2. a civic commander, a governor
3. "captain of the temple"
entries.english: From the base of G4756 and G71 or G2233; a general, that is, (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (praetor), the chief (praefect) of the (Levitical) temple wardens: - captain, magistrate.

entries.tamil:
சேனை - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. an army, band of soldiers
2. the poets equivalent to strateia
3. the host of heaven
entries.english: Feminine of a derivative of στρατός stratos (an army; from the base of G4766, as encamped); camp likeness, that is, an army, that is, (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries: - host.

entries.tamil:
சேவகர், போர்ச்சேவகர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a (common) soldier
entries.english: From a presumed derivative of the same as G4756; a camperout, that is, a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively): - soldier.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேவகமெழுது

to gather as a warrior, enlist in the army, choose to be a soldier
entries.english: From a compound of the base of G4756 and G3004 (in its original sense); to gather (or select) as a warrior, that is, enlist in the army: - choose to be a soldier.

entries.tamil:
சேனாதிபதி - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

the commander of a camp and army, a military tribune
entries.english: From G4760 and G757; a ruler of an army, that is, (specifically) a Praetorian praefect: - captain of the guard.

entries.tamil:
சேனை - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a military camp
2. soldiers in camp, an army
entries.english: From the base of G4756 and the same as G3977; a camping ground, that is, (by implication) a body of troops: - army.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - புரட்டு

1. to twist, turn awry
2. to torture, put to the rack
entries.english: From a derivative of G4762; to wrench, that is, (specifically) to torture (by the rack), but only figuratively to pervert: - wrest.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - திரும்பு, மாற்று, திருப்பு

to turn, turn round
entries.english: Strengthened from the base of G5157; to twist, that is, turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively): - convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - செல்வச்செருக்காய் வாழ்

to be wanton, to live luxuriously
entries.english: From a presumed derivative of G4764; to be luxurious: - live deliciously.

entries.tamil:
செல்வச்செருக்கு - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

excessive strength which longs to break forth, over - strength; luxury
entries.english: Akin to G4731; a “straining”, “strenuousness” or “strength”, that is, (figuratively) luxury (voluptuousness): - delicacy.

entries.tamil:
அடைக்கலான் குருவி - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

a little bird, a sparrow
entries.english: Diminutive of στρουθός strouthos (a sparrow); a little sparrow: - sparrow.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பரப்பு, விரி, விரித்துக்கொள்

to spread
entries.english: Or a simpler form στρωννύω strōnnuō strone'-noo'-o, prolonged from a still simpler form στρόω stroō stro'-o (used only as an alternate in certain tenses; probably akin to G4731 through the idea of positing); to “strew”, that is, spread (as a carpet or couch): - make bed, furnish, spread, strew.

entries.tamil:
பகைக்கப் படத்தக்க - பெயரடை

hated
entries.english: From a derivative of an obsolete, apparently primary, word στύγω stugō (to hate); hated, that is, odious: - hateful.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மந்தாரமாயிரு, மனமடி

to be sad, to be sorrowful
entries.english: From the same as G4767; to render gloomy, that is, (by implication) glower (be overcast with clouds, or sombreness of speech): - lower, be sad.

entries.tamil:
தூண், ஸ்தம்பம் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a pillar, column, pillars of fire
entries.english: From στύω stuō (to stiffen; properly akin to the base of G2476); a post (“style”), that is, (figuratively) support: - pillar.

entries.tamil:
ஸ்தோயிக்கர் - பெயரடை

Stoic

ஸ்தோயிக் மார்க்கத்தைச் சேர்ந்தவர்கள்
entries.english: From G4745; a “stoic” (as occupying a particular porch in Athens), that is, adherent of a certain philosophy: - Stoick.

entries.tamil:
நீ, நீர்,உம்முடைய, உன், உமக்கு - பெர்சிய முன்னிலை பிரதி பெயர்ச்சொல்

thou, ye
entries.english: The personal pronoun of the second person singular; thou: - thou. See also G4571, G4671, G4675; and for the plur. G5209, G5210, G5213, G5216.

entries.tamil:
உறவின் முறை, இனம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. kinship, relationship
2. kindred, relations collectively, family
entries.english: From G4773; relationship, that is, (concretely) relatives: - kindred.

entries.tamil:
இனத்தாளாகிய, உறவின் முறையான, பந்து ஜனங்களான - பெயரடை

a kinswoman
entries.english: From G4862 and G1085; a relative (by blood); by extension a fellow countryman: - cousin, kin (-sfolk, -sman).

entries.tamil:
யோசனை - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

pardon, indulgence
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and G1097; fellow knowledge, that is, concession: - permission.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடஉட்கார்

to sit together: to sit with another
entries.english: From G4862 and G2521; to seat oneself in company with: - sit with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்ந்து உட்கார், கூட உட்காரச்செய்

1. to cause to sit down together, place together
2. to sit down together
entries.english: From G4862 and G2523; to give (or take) a seat in company with: - (make) sit (down) together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடத் தீங்கனுபவி

to suffer hardships together with one
entries.english: From G4862 and G2553; to suffer hardship in company with: - be partaker of afflictions.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடத் துன்பத்தை அநுபவி

to treat ill with another; to be ill - treated in company with, share persecutions
entries.english: From G4862 and G2558; to maltreat in company with, that is, (passively) endure persecution together: - suffer affliction with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடி வரச்செய், கூடவரவழை, வரவழை

to call together, assemble
entries.english: From G4862 and G2564; to convoke: - call together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மறைக்கப்படு

to cover on all sides, to conceal entirely, to cover up completely
entries.english: From G4862 and G2572; to conceal altogether: - cover.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - குனியப்பண்ணு

to bend together, to bend completely
entries.english: From G4862 and G2578; to bend together, that is, (figuratively) to afflict: - bow down.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவா, கீழே போ

to go down with
entries.english: From G4862 and G2597; to descend in company with: - go down with.

entries.tamil:
சம்பந்தம் - பெயர்ச்சொல்.

a putting together or joint deposit approval, assent, agreement,
entries.english: From G4784; a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, that is, (figuratively) accord with: - agreement.

entries.tamil:
விைைனச்சொல் - சம்மதி

to deposit together with another
entries.english: Middle voice from G4862 and G2698; to deposit (one’s vote or opinion) in company with, that is, (figuratively) to accord with: - consent.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்த்துக்கொள்

1. to assign one a place among (sun), to vote one a place among
2. to vote against with others,
entries.english: From G4862 and a compound of G2596 and G5585; to count down in company with, that is, enroll among: - number with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்த்து அமைத்திரு, சேர்

to mix together, commingle; to unite
entries.english: From G4862 and G2767; to commingle, that is, (figuratively) to combine or assimilate: - mix with, temper together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - எழுப்பிவிடு

to move together with others
entries.english: From G4682 and G2795; to move together, that is, (specifically) to excite as a mass (to sedition): - stir up.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பிடி, அடைத்துப்போடு

to shut up
entries.english: From G4862 and G2808; to shut together, that is, include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to: - conclude, inclose, shut up.

entries.tamil:
உடன் சுதந்தரர், உடன்சுதந்தரித்துக் கொள் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fellow - heir, a joint - heir
entries.english: From G4862 and G2818; a co-heir, that is, (by analogy) participant in common: - fellow (joint) -heir, heir together, heir with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உடன்படு

to become a partaker together with others
entries.english: From G4862 and G2841; to share in company with, that is, co-participate in: - communicate (have fellowship) with, be partaker of.

entries.tamil:
கூட உடன்படுகிறவர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

participant with others in (anything), joint partner
entries.english: From G4862 and G2844; a co-participant: - companion, partake (-r, -r with).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - எடு

1. to carry or bring together, to collect
2. to carry with others, help in carrying out, the dead to be burned or buried to bury
entries.english: From G4862 and G2865; to convey together, that is, collect or bear away in company with others: - carry.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சம்பந்தப்படுத்து, ஒப்பிடு

1. to join together fitly, compound, combine
2. to compare
entries.english: From G4862 and G2919; to judge of one thing in connection with another, that is, combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance): - compare among (with).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூனியாயிரு

to bend completely forward, to be bowed together
entries.english: From G4862 and G2955; to stoop altogether, that is, be completely overcome by: - bow together.

entries.tamil:
தற்செயல் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

accident, chance
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and κυρέω kureō (to light or happen; from the base of G2962); concurrence, that is, accident: - chance.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடச் சந்தோஷப்படு

to rejoice with, take part in another's joy
entries.english: From G4862 and G5463; to sympathize in gladness, congratulate: - rejoice in (with).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கலக்கமடை, அமளியுண்டாக்கு, கலக்கமாயிரு, கலங்கப்பண்ணு

to pour together, commingle
entries.english:
Or συγχύνω sugchunō soong-khoo'-no
From G4862 and χέω “cheō” (to pour) or its alternate; to commingle promiscuously, that is, (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind): - confound, confuse, stir up, be in an uproar.

entries.tamil:
உடன்சம்பந்தங்கள் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

to use with any one, use jointly, to associate with, to have dealings with
entries.english: From G4862 and G5530; to use jointly, that is, (by implication) to hold intercourse in common: - have dealings with.

entries.tamil:
கலகம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

confusion, disturbance
entries.english: From G4797; commixture, that is, (figuratively) riotous disturbance: - confusion.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடப்பிழை

to live together with
entries.english: From G4862 and G2198; to continue to live in common with, that is, co-survive (literally or figuratively): - live with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்ந்து இணை

to fasten to one yoke, yoke together: to join together, unite
entries.english: From G4862 and the base of G2201; to yoke together, that is, (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage): - join together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடத்தர்க்கம் பண்ணு, கூட விசாரி

1. to seek or examine together
2. to discuss, dispute
entries.english: From G4862 and G2212; to investigate jointly, that is, discuss, controvert, cavil: - dispute (with), enquire, question (with), reason (together).

entries.tamil:
தர்க்கம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

mutual questioning, disputation, discussion
entries.english: From G4802; mutual questioning, that is, discussion: - disputation (-ting), reasoning.

entries.tamil:
தர்க்க சாஸ்திரி - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a disputer, a learned disputant, sophist
entries.english: From G4802; a disputant, that is, sophist: - disputer.

entries.tamil:
கூட்டாளியான - பெயரடை

yoked together
entries.english: From G4801; co-yoked, that is, (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as proper name; Syzygus, a Christian: - yokefellow.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட உயிர்ப்பி

to make one alive together with another
entries.english: From G4862 and G2227; to reanimate conjointly with (figuratively): - quicken together with.

entries.tamil:
காட்டத்தி மரம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a sycamine
entries.english: Of Hebrew origin [H8256] in imitation of G4809; a sycamore or fig tree: - sycamine tree.

entries.tamil:
அத்திமரம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fig - tree
entries.english: From G4810; a fig tree: - fig tree.

entries.tamil:
காட்டத்தி மரம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a sycomore - tree
entries.english: From G4810 and μόρον moron (the mulberry); the “sycamore” or fig tree: - sycamore tree. Compare G4807.

entries.tamil:
அத்திப்பழம் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fig, the ripe fruit of
entries.english: Apparently a primary word; a fig: - fig.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பொய்யாய்க் குற்றஞ் சாட்டு, அநியாயமாய் குற்றஞ்சாட்டு

1. to accuse wrongfully, to calumniate, to attack by malicious devices, a malignant informer, a calumniator
2. to exact money wrongfully; to extort from, defraud
entries.english: From a compound of G4810 and a derivative of G5316; to be a fig informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from Greece), “sycopant”, that is, (generally and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort): - accuse falsely, take by false accusation.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கொள்ளை கொண்டுபோ

to carry off booty
entries.english: From the base of G4813 and (the reduplicated form of) G71; to lead away as booty, that is, (figuratively) seduce: - spoil.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கொள்ளையிடு

to rob, despoil
entries.english: From a derivative of σύλλω sullō̄ (to strip; probably akin to G138; compare G4661); to despoil: - rob.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உடன் சம்பாஷணை பண்ணு. கூடப்பேசு, பேசிக்கொள், கூட ஆலோசனை பண்ணு

to talk together, converse
entries.english: From G4862 and G2980; to talk together, that is, converse: - commune (confer, talk) with, speak among.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கர்ப்பவதியாகு, கர்ப்பந்தரித்திரு, கர்ப்பத்திலே உற்பவி, பறி, பிடுங்கு, பிடிங்கிப்போடு

1. to seize, take to conceive
2. to seize for oneself
entries.english: From G4862 and G2983; to clasp, that is, seize (arrest, capture); specifically to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication to aid: - catch, conceive, help, take.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்

to gather up
entries.english: From G4862 and G3004 in its original sense; to collect: - gather (together, up).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - யோசனைபண்ணு

1. to bring together accounts, reckon up, compute,
2. to reckon with oneself, to reason
entries.english: From G4862 and G3049; to reckon together (with oneself), that is, deliberate: - reason with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - விசனப்படு

1. to affect with grief together
2. to grieve with oneself
entries.english: From G4862 and G3076; to afflict jointly, that is, (passively) sorrow at (on account of) some one: - be grieved.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சம்பவி, நேரிடு

1. to walk with the feet near together
2. to come together, meet with one
3. of things which fall out at the same time, to happen, turn out, come to pass
entries.english: From G4862 and the base of G939; to walk (figuratively transpire) together, that is, concur (take place): - be (-fall), happen (unto).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சிந்தனை பண்ணு, சந்தி, யோசனைபண்ணு

to throw together, to bring together, to converse
entries.english: From G4862 and G906; to combine, that is, (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack: - confer, encounter, help, make, meet with, ponder.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஆளு, ஆளுகைச்செய்

to reign together
entries.english: From G4862 and G936; to be co-regent (figuratively): - reign with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நிச்சயித்துக்கொள். இணைக்கப்படு

1. to cause to coalesce, to join together, put together
2. to put together in one's mind, to compare
3. to cause a person to unite with one in a conclusion or come to the same opinion, to prove, demonstrate
entries.english: From G4862 and βιβάζω bibazō (to force; causatively [by reduplication] of the base of G939); to drive together, that is, unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach: - compact, assuredly, gather, instruct, knit together, prove.

entries.tamil:
ஆலோசனைபண்ணு, ஆலோசனை சொல் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. to give counsel
2. to take counsel with others, take counsel together, to consult, deliberate
entries.english: From G4862 and G1011; to give (or take) advice jointly, that is, recommend, deliberate or determine: - consult, (give, take) counsel (together).

entries.tamil:
ஆலோசனை, யோசனை - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. counsel
2. a council, an assembly of counsellors or persons in consultation
entries.english: Neuter of a presumed derivative of G4825; advisement; specifically a deliberative body, that is, the provincial assessors or lay court: - consultation, counsel, council.

entries.tamil:
ஆலோசனைக்காரன் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

an adviser, counsellor
entries.english: From G4862 and G1012; a consultor, that is, adviser: - counsellor.

entries.tamil:
சிமியோன், சீமோன் - ஓர் ஆணின் பெயர்

Simeon, Simon

"கேள்விப்பட்டவன், கீழ்ப்படிதலுள்ளவன்"

"he has heard, obedient one"

1. யாக்கோபின் இரண்டாவது குமாரன்
2. ஆபிரகாமின் சந்ததியில் ஒருவர்
3. குழந்தை இயேசுவைத் தேவாலயத்தில் தனது கரங்களில் ஏந்தியவர்
4. நீகர் என்னப்பட்டவன்
5. அப்போஸ்தலர் பேதுரு
entries.english: From the same as G4613; Symeon (that is, Shimon), the name of five Israelites: - Simeon, Simon.

entries.tamil:
சீஷர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fellow - disciple
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and G3129; a co-learner (of Christianity): - fellowdisciple.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடச்சாட்சி கொடு, கூடச் சாட்சியிடு, கூடச் சாட்சியாக எச்சரி

to bear witness with, bear joint witness (with one)
entries.english: From G4862 and G3140; to testify jointly, that is, corroborate by (concurrent) evidence: - testify unto, (also) bear witness (with).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடப்பங்கிடு

to divide at the same time, divide together; to assign a portion
entries.english: Middle voice from G4862 and G3307; to share jointly, that is, participate in: - be partaker with.

entries.tamil:
உடன்பங்காளி - பெயரடை

partaking together with one, a joint - partaker
entries.english: From G4862 and G3353; a co-participant: - partaker.

entries.tamil:
கூடப்பின்பற்றுகிறவர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

an imitator with others
entries.english: From a presumed compound of G4862 and G3401; a co-imitator, that is, fellow votary: - follower together.

entries.tamil:
ஒப்பாயிருக்கிற - பெயரடை

having the same form as another
entries.english: From G4862 and G3444; jointly formed, that is, (figuratively) similar: - conformed to, fashioned like unto.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஒப்பாயிரு

to take on the same form as, to share the likeness of
entries.english: From G4832; to render like, that is, (figuratively) to assimilate: - make conformable unto.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பரிதபி

1. to be affected with the same feeling as another, to sympathize with
2. in reference to the wretched, to feel for, have compassion on
entries.english: From G4835; to feel “sympathy” with, that is, (by implication) to commiserate: - have compassion, be touched with a feeling of.

entries.tamil:
ஒருமனப்பட்ட - பெயரடை

suffering or feeling the like with another, sympathetic
entries.english: From G4841; having a fellow feeling (“sympathetic”), that is, (by implication) mutually commiserative: - having compassion one of another.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடிவா, கூடஇரு

1. to come together
2. to come to one's help
entries.english: From G4862 and G3854; to be present together, that is, to convene; by implication to appear in aid: - come together, stand with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட ஆறுதலடை

1. to call upon or invite or exhort at the same time or together
2. to strengthen (comfort) with others
entries.english: From G4862 and G3870; to console jointly: - comfort together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட்டிக்கொள், கூட அழைத்துக்கொள்

to take along together with
entries.english: From G4862 and G3880; to take along in company: - take with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடயிரு

to abide together
entries.english: From G4862 and G3887; to remain in company, that is, still live: - continue with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவந்திரு

to be present together
entries.english: From G4862 and G3918; to be at hand together, that is, now present: - be here present with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடப் பாடுபடு

to suffer or feel pain together
entries.english: From G4862 and G3958 (including its alternate); to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specifically persecution; to “sympathize”): - suffer with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட அனுப்பு

to send together with
entries.english: From G4862 and G3992; to despatch in company: - send with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - அணைத்துக்கொள்

1. to comprehend at once
2. to embrace completely
entries.english: From G4862 and a compound of G4012 and G2983; to take by inclosing altogether, that is, earnestly throw the arms about one: - embrace.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடக்குடி

to drink with
entries.english: From G4862 and G4095; to partake a beverage in company: - drink with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நிறைந்துவா, நிறை

1. to fill completely
2. to complete entirely, be fulfilled
entries.english: From G4862 and G4137; to implenish completely, that is, (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passively be complete): - (fully) come, fill up.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நெருக்கிப்போடு, நெருங்கிப்போடு, நெருக்கு

to choke utterly
entries.english: From G4862 and G4155; to strangle completely, that is, (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd: - choke, throng.

entries.tamil:
ஒரே நகரத்தார் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

possessing the same citizenship with others, a fellow - citizen
entries.english: From G4862 and G4177; a native of the same town, that is, (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow Christian): - fellow-citizen.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவா, கூடப்போ

1. to go or journey together
2. to come together, to assemble
entries.english: From G4862 and G4198; to journey together; by implication to assemble: - go with, resort.

entries.tamil:
பந்தி - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

a drinking - party, entertainment
entries.english: Neuter of a derivative of the alternate of G4844; a drinking party (“symposium”), that is, (by extension) a room of guests: - company.

entries.tamil:
உடன் மூப்பன் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fellow - elder
entries.english: From G4862 and G4245; a co-presbyter: - presbyter, also an elder.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நலமாயிரு, பிரயோஜனமாயிரு, தகுதியாயிரு

1. to bring together
2. to bear together
entries.english: From G4862 and G5342 (including its alternate); to bear together (contribute), that is, (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as noun) advantage: - be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit (-able for).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஒத்துக்கொள்

to consent, confess
entries.english: From G4862 and G5346; to say jointly, that is, assent to: - consent unto.

entries.tamil:
ஜனங்கள் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

one who is of the same people, a fellow - countryman
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of G5443; a co-tribesman, that is, native of the same country: - countryman.

entries.tamil:
இணைக்கப்பட்ட - பெயரடை

1. connate, congenital, innate, implanted by birth or nature
2. grown together, united with, planted together
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of G5453; grown along with (connate), that is, (figuratively) closely united to: - planted together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவளர்

1. to cause to grow together
2. to grow together, grow with
entries.english: From G4862 and G5453; passively to grow jointly: - spring up with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஒருமனப்பட்டிரு. ஒத்துக்கொள், கூடசம்மதி, ஒத்திரு

1. to sound together
2. to agree together
3. to agree with one in making a bargain, to make an agreement, to bargain
entries.english: From G4859; to be harmonious, that is, (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact): - agree (together, with).

entries.tamil:
இசைவு - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

concord, agreement
entries.english: From G4856; accordance: - concord.

entries.tamil:
கீதவாத்தியம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

music
entries.english: From G4859; unison of sound (“symphony”), that is, a concert of instruments (harmonious note): - music.

entries.tamil:
சம்மதித்த - பெயரடை

harmonious, accordant, agreeing
entries.english: From G4862 and G5456; sounding together (alike), that is, (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement): - consent.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - தொகைபார்

to compute, count up
entries.english: From G4862 and G5585; to compute jointly: - reckon.

entries.tamil:
ஏகசிந்தையுள்ள - பெயரடை

of one mind, of one accord
entries.english: From G4862 and G5590; co-spirited, that is, similar in sentiment: - like-minded.

entries.tamil:
ஓடு, உடன் - இடைச்சொல்

with, together
entries.english: A primary preposition denoting union; with or together (but much closer than G3326 or G3844), that is, by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc.: - beside, with. In compounds it has similar applications, including completeness.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடிவரச்செய், கூடிவா, கூடியிரு, கூட்டிச்சேர்

1. to gather together, to gather
2. to bring together, assemble
3. to receive hospitably, to entertain
entries.english: From G4862 and G71; to lead together, that is, collect or convene; specifically to entertain (hospitably): - + accompany, assemble (selves, together), bestow, come together, gather (selves together, up, together), lead into, resort, take in.

entries.tamil:
ஜெபஆலயம், ஆலயம், கூட்டம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. an assembly of men
2. a synagogue
entries.english: From (the reduplicated form of) G4863; an assemblage of persons; specifically a Jewish “synagogue” (the meeting or the place); by analogy a Christian church: - assembly, congregation, synagogue.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடப்போராடு

to strive together with one, to help one in striving
entries.english: From G4862 and G75; to struggle in company with, that is, (figuratively) to be a partner (assistant): - strive together with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொால் - கூடப்போராடு, கூடப்பிரயாசப்படு

to strive at the same time with another
entries.english: From G4862 and G118; to wrestle in company with, that is, (figuratively) to seek jointly: - labour with, strive together for.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடியிரு, கூடிவரச்செய், கூடு

to gather together with others; to assemble
entries.english: From G4862 and ἀθροίζω athroizō (to hoard); to convene: - call (gather) together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கணக்குப்பார், கணக்குக்கேள்

1. to take up together with another or others
2. to bring together with others
entries.english: From G4862 and G142; to make up together, that is, (figuratively) to compute (an account): - reckon, take.

entries.tamil:
கூடக் காவலில் கட்டுண்டவர்கள். கூடக் காவலில் வைக்கப் பட்டிருக்கிறவர்கள், கூடக் காவலிலிருக்கிறவர்கள் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fellow - prisoner
entries.english: From G4862 and G164; a co-captive: - fellowprisoner.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பின்செல், பின்வா

to follow together with others, to accompany
entries.english: From G4862 and G190; to accompany: - follow.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட போஜனம் பண்ணு, கூடச்சேர்

to gather together; assemble
entries.english: From G4862 and ἁλίζω halizō (to throng); to accumulate, that is, convene: - assemble together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவா, கூடப்போ

to ascend at the same time, come up together with to a higher place
entries.english: From G4862 and G305; to ascend in company with: - come up with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடப்பந்தியிரு, கூடயிரு

to recline together, feast together
entries.english: From G4862 and G345; to recline in company with (at a meal): - sit (down, at the table, together) with (at meat).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உடன் கலந்திரு

1. to mix up together; to keep company with, be intimate with
2. to take rest together with
entries.english: From G4862 and a compound of G303 and G3396; to mix up together, that is, (figuratively) associate with: - (have, keep) company (with).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட இளைப்பாறு

refresh with, to recruit oneself in company with
entries.english: Middle voice from G4862 and G373; to recruit oneself in company with: - refresh with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நேரிடு, எதிர்கொள், எதிர்ப்படு

to meet with
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of G473; to meet with; figuratively to occur: - befall, meet.

entries.tamil:
எதிர்கொள்ளல் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a meeting with
entries.english: From G4876; a meeting with: - meet.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உதவிசெய்

to lay hold along with, to strife to obtain with others, help in obtaining
entries.english: From G4862 and G482; to take hold of opposite together, that is, co-operate (assist): - help.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - இணங்கு, இழுப்புண்டு

to lead away with or together
entries.english: From G4862 and G520; to take off together, that is, transport with (seduce, passively yield): - carry (lead) away with, condescend.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடமரி,கூடச்சாகு

to die together
entries.english: From G4862 and G599; to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively) similarly to: - be dead (die) with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடச்சேதமாகு

to destroy together
entries.english: From G4862 and G622; to destroy (middle voice or passive voice, be slain) in company with: - perish with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட அனுப்பு

to send with
entries.english: From G4862 and G649; to despatch (on an errand) in company with: - send you.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - இசைவாய்க்கூட இணை, இசைவாய்க்கூட்டி இணைக்கப்படு

to join closely together; to frame together
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of a compound of G719 and G3004 (in its original sense of laying); to render close jointed together, that is, organize compactly: - be fitly framed (joined) together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பிடி, இழுத்துகொள், அகப்படு

snatch together, seize, catch
entries.english: From G4862 and G726; to snatch together, that is, seize: - catch.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவளர்

to cause to grow together
entries.english: From G4862 and G837; to increase (grow up) together: - grow together.

entries.tamil:
கட்டு - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. that which binds together, a band, bond
2. that which is bound together, a bundle
entries.english: From G4862 and G1199; a joint tie, that is, ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control: - band, bond.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடக்கட்டு

1. to tie together, to bind together
2. to bind or fasten on all sides
3. to bind just as (jointly with) another
entries.english: From G4862 and G1210; to bind with, that is, (passively) be a fellow prisoner (figuratively): - be bound with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட மகிமைப்படு

1. to approve together, join in approving
2. to glorify together
entries.english: From G4862 and G1392; to exalt to dignity in company (that is, similarly) with: - glorify together.

entries.tamil:
உடன் வேலைக்காரர், உடன் பணிவிடைக்காரர், உடன் ஊழியக்காரர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a fellow - servant
2. the associate of a servant
entries.english: From G4862 and G1401; a co-slave, that is, servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine): - fellowservant.

entries.tamil:
கூட்டமாய் ஓடு - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a running together, concourse
entries.english: From (the alternate of) G4936; a running together, that is, (riotous) concourse: - run together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட எழுப்பு, கூட எழு

to raise together, to cause to rise together
entries.english: From G4862 and G1453; to rouse (from death) in company with, that is, (figuratively) to revivify (spiritually) in resemblance to: - raise up together, rise with.

entries.tamil:
ஆலோசனைச்சங்கம், சங்கம் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. any session or assembly of persons deliberating or adjudicating
2. the Sanhedrin, the great council at Jerusalem
3. the smaller tribunal or council
entries.english: Neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4862 and the base of G1476; a joint session, that is, (specifically) the Jewish Sanhedrim; by analogy a subordinate tribunal: - council.

entries.tamil:
மனச்சாட்சி, ஆத்துமா - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. the consciousness
2. the soul
entries.english: From a prolonged form of G4894; co-perception, that is, moral consciousness: - conscience.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நிச்சயித்துக் கொள், அறி

1. to see (have seen) together with others
2. to see (have seen) in one's mind, with oneself
entries.english: From G4862 and G1492; to see completely; used (like its primary) only in two past tenses, respectively meaning to understand or become aware, and to be conscious or (clandestinely) informed of: - consider, know, be privy, be ware of.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடயிரு

to be with
entries.english: From G4862 and G1510 (including its various inflections); to be in company with, that is, present at the time: - be with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவா

to come together
entries.english: From G4862 and εῖμι eimi (to go); to assemble: - gather together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடப்போ

to enter together
entries.english: From G4862 and G1525; to enter in company with: - go in with, go with into.

entries.tamil:
வழித்துணை - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fellow - traveller, companion in travel
entries.english: From G4862 and the base of G1553; a co-absentee from home, that is, fellow traveller: - companion in travel, travel with.

entries.tamil:
கூடத்தெரிந்து கொள்ளப்பட்ட - பெயரடை

elected or chosen (by God to eternal life)
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and G1586; chosen in company with, that is, co-elect (fellow Christian): - elected together with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சமாதானமாகு

to drive together, to compel; to constrain by exhortation, urge
entries.english: From G4862 and G1643; to drive together, that is, (figuratively) exhort (to reconciliation): - + set at one again.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடசாட்சிகொடு

to attest together with; to join in bearing witness, to unite in adding testimony
entries.english: From G4862 and G1957; to testify further jointly, that is, unite in adding evidence: - also bear witness.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - வழித்துணையாய் வா

to follow with, to accompany
entries.english: Middle voice from G4862 and a primary word ἕπω hepō (to follow); to attend (travel) in company with: - accompany.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - வழித்துணையாய் வா

to follow with, to accompany
entries.english: From G4904; to be a fellow worker, that is, co-operate: - help (work) with, work (-er) together.

entries.tamil:
உடன் வேலைசெய்யும், உடன் வேலையாளான சகாயரான - பெயரடை

a companion in work, fellow - worker
entries.english: From a presumed compound of G4862 and the base of G2041; a co-laborer, that is, coadjutor: - companion in labour, (fellow-) helper (-labourer, -worker), labourer together with, workfellow.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவா

1. to come together
2. to go (depart) or come with one, to accompany one
entries.english: From G4862 and G2064; to convene, depart in company with, associate with, or (specifically) cohabit (conjugally): - accompany, assemble (with), come (together), come (company, go) with, resort.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடச்சாப்பிடு, கூடப் புசி, கூடப்போஜனம் பண்ணு

to eat with, take food together
entries.english: From G4862 and G2068 (including its alternate); to take food in company with: - eat with.

entries.tamil:
புத்தி, அறிவு, விவேகம், மனது, உணர்வு - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a running together, a flowing together
2. understanding
entries.english: From G4920; a mental putting together, that is, intelligence or (concretely) the intellect: - knowledge, understanding.

entries.tamil:
கல்விமான்களான, விவேகமுள்ள, புத்திசாலியான - பெயரடை

intelligent, having understanding, wise, learned
entries.english: From G4920; mentally put (or putting) together, that is, sagacious: - prudent. Compare G5429.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உடன்படு, சம்மதி, பிரியப்படு

1. to be pleased together with, to approve together
2. to be pleased at the same time with, consent, agree to
entries.english: From G4862 and G2106; to think well of in common, that is, assent to, feel gratified with: - allow, assent, be pleased, have pleasure.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட விருந்துண்ணு

to entertain together
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of a presumed compound of G2095 and a derivative of G2192 (meaning to be in good condition, that is, [by implication] to fare well, or feast); to entertain sumptuously in company with, that is, (middle or passive voice) to revel together: - feast with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்ந்து எழும்பு

to place over or appoint together
entries.english: From G4862 and G2186; to stand up together, that is, to resist (or assault) jointly: - rise up together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடக்கிட, அடைத்துக்கொள், வருத்தப்பட்டுக்கிட

1. to hold together
2. to hold together with constraint, to compress
3. to hold completely
entries.english: From G4862 and G2192; to hold together, that is, to compress (the ears, with a crowd or siege) or arrest (a prisoner); figuratively to compel, perplex, afflict, preoccupy: - constrain, hold, keep in, press, lie sick of, stop, be in a strait, straiten, be taken with, throng.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பிரியமாயிரு

1. to rejoice together with
2. once to rejoice or delight with oneself or inwardly
entries.english: Middle voice from G4862 and the base of G2237; to rejoice in with oneself, that is, feel satisfaction concerning: - delight.

entries.tamil:
வழக்கம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. contact (with one), intimacy
2. custom
3. a being used to
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and G2239; mutual habituation, that is, usage: - custom.

entries.tamil:
ஒரே வயதுள்ளவர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

one of the same age, all equal in age
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of G2244; a co-aged person, that is, alike in years: - equal.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட அடக்கம் பண்ணு

to bury together with
entries.english: From G4862 and G2290; to inter in company with, that is, (figuratively) to assimilate spiritually (to Christ by a sepulture as to sin): - bury with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நொறுங்கிப்போ

to break to pieces, shatter
entries.english: From G4862 and θλάω thlaō (to crush); to dash together, that is, shatter: - break.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நெருக்கு

to press together, press on all sides
entries.english: From G4862 and G2346; to compress, that is, crowd on all sides: - throng.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உடைந்துபோகப் பண்ணு

to break in pieces, to crush
entries.english: From G4862 and θρύπτω thruptō (to crumble); to crush together, that is, (figuratively) to dispirit: - break.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உணர்ந்துகொள், அறிந்துகொள், புத்திமானாயிரு

to understand, to comprehend, to perceive, to have insight into
entries.english: From G4862 and ἵημι hiēmi (to send); to put together, that is, (mentally) to comprehend; by implication to act piously: - consider, understand, be wise.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மெச்சிக்கொள், நிலைகொண்டிரு, புகழ், விளங்கப்பண்ணு

1. to recommend, to commend, to give approval to; to show, to prove, to demonstrate
2. to hold together, to have one's proper place to be formed, to consist to stand with or beside
entries.english: From G4862 and G2476 (including its collateral forms); to set together, that is, (by implication) to introduce (favorably), or (figuratively) to exhibit; intransitively to stand near, or (figuratively) to constitute: - approve, commend, consist, make, stand (with).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடப்பிரயாணம் பண்ணு

to journey with, travel in company with
entries.english: From G4862 and G3593; to travel in company with: - journey with.

entries.tamil:
பிரயாணக்காரரின் கூட்டம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a journey in company
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and G3598 (“synod”); companionship on a journey, that is, (by implication) a caravan: - company.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடவாழ்

to dwell together
entries.english: From G4862 and G3611; to reside together (as a family): - dwell together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட்டிக்கட்டு

to build together
entries.english: From G4862 and G3618; to construct, that is, (passively) to compose (in company with other Christians, figuratively): - build together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உடன்பேசு

to talk with
entries.english: From G4862 and G3656; to converse mutually: - talk with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - அடுத்ததாயிரு

to border on, be contiguous to
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of a compound of the base of G3674 and the base of G3725; to border together, that is, adjoin: - join hard.

entries.tamil:
இடுக்கண், இடுக்கம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a holding together, narrowing; narrows
entries.english: From G4912; restraint, that is, (figuratively) anxiety: - anguish, distress.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கற்பி

1. to put in order with or together, to arrange
2. to (put together), constitute, to prescribe, appoint
entries.english: From G4862 and G5021; to arrange jointly, that is, (figuratively) to direct: - appoint.

entries.tamil:
முடிவு, கடைசிக்காலம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

completion, consummation, end
entries.english: From G4931; entire completion, that is, consummation (of a dispensation): - end.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - முடி, நிறைவேறு, ஏற்படுத்து

1. to end together or at the same time
2. to end completely; bring to an end, finish, complete:
3. to accomplish, bring to fulfillment
4. to effect, make
5. to finish
entries.english: From G4862 and G5055; to complete entirely; generally to execute (literally or figuratively): - end, finish, fulfil, make.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சீக்கிரம் நிறைவேற்று

1. to cut to pieces
2. to cut short
entries.english: From G4862 and the base of G5114; to contract by cutting, that is, (figuratively) do concisely (speedily): - (cut) short.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பத்திரப்படுத்து, பாதுகாப்புசெய், பத்திரப்பட்டிரு, பத்திரமாய் வை

1. to preserve (a thing from perishing or being lost)
2. to keep within oneself, keep in mind
entries.english: From G4862 and G5083; to keep closely together, that is, (by implication) to conserve (from ruin); mentally to remember (and obey): - keep, observe, preserve.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உடன்படு, இசை, கட்டுப்பாடு செய்

1. to place in one's mind, resolve, determine; to make an agreement, to engage
2. to assent to, to agree to
entries.english: Middle voice from G4862 and G5087; to place jointly, that is, (figuratively) to consent (bargain, stipulate), concur: - agree assent, covenant.

entries.tamil:
சுருக்கமாய் - வினையடை

concisely briefly, in few words
entries.english: Adverb from a derivative of G4932; concisely (briefly): - a few words.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்ந்து ஒடு, கூடஓடு

1. to run together
2. to run along with others
entries.english: From G4862 and G5143 (including its alternate); to rush together (hastily assemble) or headlong (figuratively): - run (together, with).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நெரி, தகர், உடை, நருங்கு, கசக்கு, முறி, நசுக்கு, நொறுக்கு

to break, to break in pieces, shiver
entries.english: From G4862 and the base of G5147; to crush completely, that is, to shatter (literally or figuratively): - break (in pieces), broken to shivers (+ -hearted), bruise.

entries.tamil:
நாசம் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. that which is broken or shattered, a fracture
2. calamity, ruin, destruction
entries.english: From G4937; concussion or utter fracture (properly concretely), that is, complete ruin: - destruction.

entries.tamil:
கூட வளர்க்கப்பட்ட - பெயரடை

nourished with one
entries.english: From G4862 and G5162 (in a passive sense); a fellow nursling, that is, comrade: - brought up with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடச்சேர்

to meet with, come to, (come at) one
entries.english: From G4862 and G5177; to chance together, that is, meet with (reach): - come at.

entries.tamil:
சிந்திகேயாள் - ஒரு பெண்ணின் பெயர்

Syntyche

"வெற்றி, தற்செயல் நிகழ்ச்சி"

"success, coincidence"

பிலிப்பி சபையைச் சேர்ந்த ஒரு ஸ்திரீ
entries.english: From G4940; an accident; Syntyche, a Christian female: - Syntyche.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட மாயம் பண்ணு

to dissemble with
entries.english: From G4862 and G5271; to act hypocritically in concert with: - dissemble with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூட உதவிசெய்

to help together
entries.english: From G4862 and a derivative of a compound of G5259 and the base of G2041; to be a co-auxiliary, that is, assist: - help together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்ந்து பிரசவ வேதனைப்படு

1. to feel the pains of travail with, be in travail together
2. to undergo agony (like a woman in childbirth) along with
entries.english: From G4862 and G5605; to have (parturition) pangs in company (concert, simultaneously) with, that is, (figuratively) to sympathize (in expectation of relief from suffering): - travail in pain together.

entries.tamil:
இரகசிய ஏற்பாடு - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a swearing together; a conspiracy
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and G3660; a swearing together, that is, (by implication) a plot: - conspiracy.

entries.tamil:
சிரகூசா - ஓர் இடத்தின் பெயர்

Syracuse

சிசிலியாவிலுள்ள ஒரு துறைமுகப் பட்டிணம்
entries.english: Plural of uncertain derivation; Syracusae, the capital of Sicily: - Syracuse.

entries.tamil:
சீரியா - ஓர் இடத்தின் பெயர்

Syria
entries.english: Probably of Hebrew origin [H6865]; Syria (that is, Tsyria or Tyre), a region of Asia: - Syria.

entries.tamil:
சிரியா தேசத்தான் - ஓர் ஆணின் பெயர்

a Syrian
"of Syria"
entries.english: From the same as G4947; a Syran (that is, probably Tyrian), a native of Syria: - Syrian.

entries.tamil:
சீரோபேனிக்கேயாள் - ஸ்திரீ

a Syrophoenician woman
entries.english: Feminine of a compound of G4948 and the same as G5403; a Syro-Phaenician woman, that is, a female native of Phaenicia in Syria: - Syrophenician.

entries.tamil:
சொரிமணல் - ஒரு இடத்தின் பெயர்

Syrtis

ஆப்பிரிக்க தேசத்தின் கடற்பகுதியில் சொரிமணல் நிறைந்த பகுதியின் பெயர்
entries.english: From G4951; a shoal (from the sand drawn thither by the waves), that is, the Syrtis Major or great bay on the North coast of Africa: - quicksands.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - இழுத்துக்கொள், இழு

to draw, to drag
entries.english: Probably akin to G138; to trail: - drag, draw, hale.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - அலைக்கழி

to convulse completely
entries.english: From G4862 and G4682; to rend completely, that is, (by analogy) to convulse violently: - throw down.

entries.tamil:
குறிப்பு - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

a common sign or concerted signal, a sign given according to agreement
entries.english: Neuter of a compound of G4862 and the base of G4591; a sign in common, that is, preconcerted signal: - token.

entries.tamil:
ஒரே சரீரத்திற்குள்ளான - பெயரடை

belonging to the same body
entries.english: From G4862 and G4983; of a joint body, that is, (figuratively) a fellow member of the Christian community: - of the same body.

entries.tamil:
கலகம் பண்ணுகிறவர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a companion in insurrection, fellow - rio ter
entries.english: From a compound of G4862 and a derivative of G4714; a fellow insurgent: - make insurrection with.

entries.tamil:
உபசார - பெயரடை

commendatory, introductory
entries.english: From a derivative of G4921; introductory, that is, recommendatory: - of commendation.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - கூடச் சிலுவையில் அறை

to crucify along with
entries.english: From G4862 and G4717; to impale in company with (literally or figuratively): - crucify with.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சுற்று, குறுகியதாயிரு

1. to draw together, contact
2. to roll together, wrap up, wrap round with bandages, etc., to enshroud
entries.english: From G4862 and G4724; to send (draw) together, that is, enwrap (enshroud a corpse for burial), contract (an interval): - short, wind up.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சேர்ந்து தொனி

to groan together
entries.english: From G4862 and G4727; to moan jointly, that is, (figuratively) experience a common calamity: - groan together.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சரி

to stand or march in the same row (file) with
entries.english: From G4862 and G4748; to file together (as soldiers in ranks), that is, (figuratively) to correspond to: - answer to.

entries.tamil:
உடன் சேவகன் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a fellow - soldier
