1. preciousness, costliness; an abundance of costly things
2. worth, excellence
entries.english: From G5093; expensiveness, that is, (by implication) magnificence: - costliness.

entries.tamil:
தீமோத்தேயு - ஓர் ஆணின் பெயர்

Timothy

தேவனுக்கு முக்கியமானவர்"

"precious one of God"

லீஸ்திராவில் வசித்தவன் - இவனுடைய தாயார் ஒரு யூதஸ்திரீ - இவனுடைய தகப்பன் ஒரு கிரேக்கன்
entries.english: From G5092 and G2316; dear to God; Timotheus, a Christian: - Timotheus, Timothy.

entries.tamil:
தீமோன் - ஓர் ஆணின் பெயர்

Timon

"விலைமதிப்பு மிக்கது"

"precious, valuable"

எருசலேமிலுள்ள சபையின் ஏழு மூப்பர்களில் ஒருவன்
entries.english: From G5092; valuable; Timon, a Christian: - Timon.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - தண்டிக்கப்படு

1. to succor, come to the help of
2. to avenge
3. to take vengeance on one, to punish
entries.english: From a compound of G5092 and οὖρος ouros (a guard); properly to protect one’s honor, that is, to avenge (inflict a penalty): - punish.

entries.tamil:
ஆக்கினை - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a rendering help; assistance
2. vengeance, penalty, punishment
entries.english: From G5097; vindication, that is, (by implication) a penalty: - punishment.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - தண்டனை அடை

to pay, to recompense
entries.english: Strengthened for a primary word τίω tiō (which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses); to pay a price, that is, as a penalty: - be punished with.

entries.tamil:
சில, யாதொன்று - எதிர்மறை பிரதிப் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a certain, a certain one
entries.english: An enclitic indefinite pronoun; some or any person or object: - a (kind of), any (man, thing, thing at all), certain (thing), divers, he (every) man, one (X thing), ought, + partly, some (man, -body, -thing, -what), (+ that no-) thing, what (-soever), X wherewith, whom [-soever], whose ([-soever]).

entries.tamil:
என்ன, எதினால் - வரையறுக்கப்படாத பிரதிபெயர்ச்சொல்

who, which, what?
entries.english: Probably emphatic of G5100; an interrogitive pronoun, who, which or what (in direct or indirect questions): - every man, how (much), + no (-ne, thing), what (manner, thing), where ([-by, -fore, -of, -unto, -with, -withal]), whether, which, who (-m, -se), why.

entries.tamil:
மேல் விலாசம் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a title; an inscription
entries.english: Of Latin origin; a titulus or “title” (placard): - title.

entries.tamil:
தீத்து - ஓர் ஆணின் பெயர்

Titus

ஒரு புறஜாதி கிறிஸ்தவனுடைய பெயர்
entries.english: Of Latin origin but uncertain significance; Titus, a Christian: - Titus.

entries.tamil:
ஆகிலும் - சொல்லைச் சேர்ந்திருக்கிற துணைக்கூறு, பிற்சேர்க்கை

to undergo, to suffer
entries.english: Probably for the dative case of G3588; an enclitic particle of asseveration by way of contrast; in sooth: - [used only with other particles in compounds, as G2544, G3305, G5105, G5106, etc.]

entries.tamil:
ஆகையால் - அனுமான பிற்சேர்க்கை

wherefore then, for which reason, therefore, consequently
entries.english: From G5104 and G1063 and G3767; truly for then, that is, consequently: - there- (where-) fore.

entries.tamil:
ஆதலால், ஆகையால், அப்படியானால் - முற்சேர்க்கை அல்லது பிற்சேர்க்கை

therefore, then, accordingly
entries.english: From G5104 and G3568; truly now, that is, accordingly: - then, therefore.

entries.tamil:
போல - பெயரடை

down, such
entries.english: (Including the other inflections); from a derivative of G5104 and G1161; such like then, that is, so great: - such.

entries.tamil:
இப்படிப் பட்ட, இதுபோல, இந்தப்படி - ஒப்புமைப் பெயரடை

such as this, of this kind or sort
entries.english: (Including the other inflections); from G5104 and G3778; truly this, that is, of this sort (to denote character or individuality): - like, such (an one).

entries.tamil:
சுவர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a wall
entries.english: Another form of G5038; a wall: - wall.

entries.tamil:
பிறப்பு, வட்டி - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. birth
2. interest of money, usury
entries.english: From the base of G5088; interest on money loaned (as a produce): - usury.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - துணிந்திரு. கண்டிப்பாயிரு

to dare
entries.english: From τόλμα tolma (boldness; probably itself from the base of G5056 through the idea of extreme conduct); to venture (objectively or in act; while G2292 is rather subjective or in feeling); by implication to be courageous: - be bold, boldly, dare, durst.

entries.tamil:
அதிக தைரியமான - பெயரடை

more boldly
entries.english: Neuter of the compound of a derivative of the bse of G5111 (as adverb); more daringly, that is, with greater confidence than otherwise: - the more boldly.

entries.tamil:
துணிகரக்காரர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a daring man
entries.english: From G5111; a daring (audacious) man: - presumptuous.

entries.tamil:
கருக்குள்ள - பெயரடை

sharper
entries.english: Compound of a derivative of the primary word τέμνω temnō (to cut; more comprehensive or decisive than G2875, as if by a single stroke; whereas that implies repeated blows, like hacking); more keen: - sharper.

entries.tamil:
வில் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

a bow
entries.english: From the base of G5088; a bow (apparently as the simplest fabric): - bow.

entries.tamil:
புஷ்பராகம் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

topaz, a greenish - yellow precious stone
entries.english: Neuter of a presumed derivative (alternate) of τόπάζος topazos (a “topaz”; of uncertain origin); a gem, probably the chrysolite: - topaz.

entries.tamil:
இடம், ஸ்தலம், ஸ்தானம் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

place
entries.english: Apparently a primary word; a spot (generally in space, but limited by occupancy; whereas G5561 is a larger but particular locality), that is, location (as a position, home, tract, etc.); figuratively condition, opportunity; specifically a scabbard: - coast, licence, place, X plain, quarter, + rock, room, where.

entries.tamil:
இப்படிப்பட்ட, இத்தனை, இவ்வளவு - ஒப்புமை பெயரடை

so great
entries.english: From τόσος tosos (so much; apparently from G3588 and G3739) and G3778 (including its variations); so vast as this, that is, such (in quantity, amount, number or space): - as large, so great (long, many, much), these many.

entries.tamil:
அப்பொழுது, அதுமுதல், ஆகிலும் - ஒப்புமை வினையடை

then; at that time
entries.english: From (the neuter of) G3588 and G3753; the when, that is, at the time that (of the past or future, also in consecution): - that time, then.

entries.tamil:
அவைேடய - ஆறாம் வேற்றுமை

of this person, his
entries.english: Properly the genitive case of G3588; sometimes used for G5127; of this person: - his.

entries.tamil:
அதுவுமில்லாமல், அதற்குப் பதிலாக - வினையடை

on the contrary, contrariwise
entries.english: Contraction for the neuter of G3588 and G1726; on the contrary: - contrariwise.

entries.tamil:
பேர்கொண்ட - வினையடை

by name
entries.english: Contraction for the neuter of G3588 and G3686; the name (is): - named.

entries.tamil:
அதாவது, அர்த்தம் பண்ணும்படிக்கு, ஆனவனை, அவனை, அந்த, இந்த அதிலும், தங்கள் - இடைச்சொல்

this for
entries.english: Contraction for G5124 and G2076; that is: - that is (to say).

entries.tamil:
இது, ஆகையால், இதை, அது, இருக்கிறபடியால், இதினிமித்தம், இதெல்லாம், இப்படி, அப்படி, அவைகள், படியினால் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற ஒருமை முதல் வேற்றுமை

the same, there, this, thus, so, that
entries.english: Neuter, singular, nomitive or accusative of G3778; that thing: - here [-unto], it, partly, self [-same], so, that (intent), the same, there [-fore, -unto], this, thus, where [-fore].

entries.tamil:
இவைகள், இந்த, போல, இவை, இப்படி, அவைகள், இதோ - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற நான்காம் வேற்றுமை பன்மை

such, them, there, these, this, those
entries.english: Dative, plural, masculine or neuter of G3778; to (for, in, with or by) these (persons or things): - such, them, there [-in, -with], these, this, those.

entries.tamil:
இந்த, அவனை, அதற்கு, இவனை, அவரை குறித்த - இரண்டாம் வேற்றுமை ஆண்பால் ஒருமை

him, the same, there, this
entries.english: Accusative, singular, masculine of G3778; this (person, as object of verb or preposition): - him, the same, that, this.

entries.tamil:
இந்த, இம்மட்டில், அந்த, அது, இவர், இப்படிப்பட்ட - ஆறாம் வேற்றுமை ஆண்பால் ஒருமை

such manner of, that, thence, there about, this, thus
entries.english: Genitive singular masculine or neuter of G3778; of (from or concerning) this (person or thing): - here [-by], him, it, + such manner of, that, thence [-forth], thereabout, this, thus.

entries.tamil:
இத்தனை, இந்த, இந்த, இவர்கள், அவர்கள், இப்படிப்பட்டவர்கள் - இரண்டாம் வேற்றுமை ஆண்பால் பன்மை

such, them, these, this
entries.english: Accusative plural masculine of G3778; these (persons, as object of verb or preposition): - such, them, these, this.

entries.tamil:
ஒருவன், அது, இவன், இந்த - நான்காம் வேற்றுமை ஆண்பால் ஒருமை

him, one, the same, there, this
entries.english: Dative singular masculine or neuter of G3778; to (in, with or by) this (person or thing): - here [-by, -in], him, one, the same, there [-in], this.

entries.tamil:
இந்த, இதற்கு, அவைகள், இதிலும் - ஆறாம் வேற்றுமை ஆண்பால் பன்மை

such, their, these, they, this sort, those
entries.english: Genitive plural masculine or neuter of G3778; of (from or concerning) these (persons or things): - such, their, these (things), they, this sort, those.

entries.tamil:
வெள்ளாட்டுக்கடா - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a he - goat
entries.english: From the base of G5176; a he goat (as a gnawer): - goat.

entries.tamil:
மேஜை, பலகை, பந்தி - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a table, a banquet, feast
entries.english: Probably contracted from G5064 and G3979; a table or stool (as being four legged), usually for food (figuratively a meal); also a counter for money (figuratively a broker’s office for loans at interest): - bank, meat, table.

entries.tamil:
காசுக்காரர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a money - changer, broker, banker
entries.english: From G5132; a money broker or banker: - exchanger.

entries.tamil:
காயம் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

a wound
entries.english: From the base of τιτρώσκω titrōskō (to wound; akin to the base of G2352, G5147, G5149, etc.); a wound: - wound.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - காயப்படு, காயப்படுத்து

to wound
entries.english: From G5134; to inflict a wound: - wound.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நிர்வாணமாயும் வெளியரங்கமாயும் ஆக்குதல்

1. to seize and twist the neck or throat
2. to bend back the neck of the victim to be slain, to lay bare or expose by bending back
entries.english: From G5137; to seize by the throat or neck, that is, to expose the gullet of a victim for killing (generally to lay bare): - opened.

entries.tamil:
கழுத்து - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

the neck
entries.english: Probably from G5143 (through the idea of mobility); the throat (neck), that is, (figuratively) life: - neck.

entries.tamil:
கரடான, பாறை - பெயரடை

rough
entries.english: Perhaps strengthened from the base of G4486 (as if jagged by rents); uneven, rocky (reefy): - rock, rough.

entries.tamil:
திராகொனித்தி - ஓர் இடத்தின் பெயர்

Trachonitis

"கடினமானது, கல் நிறைந்த மாகாணம்"

"rough, stony district"
entries.english: From a derivative of G5138; rough district; Trachonitis, a region of Syria: - Trachonitis.

entries.tamil:
மூன்று - பெயரடை

three
entries.english: A primary (plural) number; “three”: - three.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நடுங்கு, அஞ்சியிரு

to tremble
entries.english: Strengthened from a primary word τρέω treō (to “dread”, “terrify”); to “tremble” or fear: - be afraid, trembling.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - போஜனங்கொடு, பிழைப்பூட்டு, போஷிக்கப்படு

to nourish, support; to feed
entries.english: A primary verb (properly θρέφω threphō; but perhaps strengthened from the base of G5157 through the idea of convolution); properly to stiffen, that is, fatten (by implication to cherish [with food, etc.], pamper, rear): - bring up, feed, nourish.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஒடு, பரப்பு

to run
entries.english: Apparently a primary verb (properly θρέχω threchō; compare G2359); which uses δρέμω dremō, drem'-o (the base of G1408) as an alternate in certain tenses; to run or walk hastily (literally or figuratively): - have course, run.

entries.tamil:
முப்பது - பெயரடை

thirty
entries.english: The decade of G5140; thirty: - thirty.

entries.tamil:
முந்நூறு - பெயரடை

three hundred
entries.english: Plural from G5140 and G1540; three hundred: - three hundred.

entries.tamil:
முட்பூண்டு - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a thistle, a prickly wild plant
entries.english: From G5140 and G956; properly a crow foot (three pronged obstruction in war), that is, (by analogy) a thorny plant (caltrop): - brier, thistle.

entries.tamil:
பாதை - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a worn way, a path
entries.english: From τρίβω tribō (to “rub”; akin to τείρω teirō, τρύω truō, and the base of G5131, G5134); a rut or worn track: - path.

entries.tamil:
மூன்று வருஷகாலம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a space of three years
entries.english: From a compound of G5140 and G2094; a three years' period (triennium): - space of three years.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பல்லைக்கடி

to squeak, make a shrill cry
entries.english: Apparently a primary verb; to creak (squeak), that is, (by analogy) to grate the teeth (in frenzy): - gnash.

entries.tamil:
மூன்றுமாதம் - பெயரடை

of three months
entries.english: Neuter of a compound of G5140 and G3376 as noun; a three months' space: - three months.

entries.tamil:
மூன்றுதரம் - வினையடை

thrice
entries.english: Adverb from G5140; three times: - three times, thrice.

entries.tamil:
மூன்று மாடி - பெயரடை

having three roofs or stories
entries.english: Neuter of a compound of G5140 and G4721 as noun; a third roof (story): - third loft.

entries.tamil:
மூவாயிரம் - பெயரடை

three thousand
entries.english: From G5151 and G5507; three times a thousand: - three thousand.

entries.tamil:
மூன்றாம் - பெயரடை

the third
entries.english: From G5140; third; neuter (as noun) a third part, or (as adverb) a (or the) third time, thirdly: - third (-ly).

entries.tamil:
கம்பளியாலான - பெயரடை

made of hair
entries.english: From G2359; hairy, that is, made of hair (mohair): - of hair.

entries.tamil:
நடுக்கம் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a trembling, quaking with fear
entries.english: From G5141; a “trembling”, that is, quaking with fear: - + tremble (-ing).

entries.tamil:
மாறுதல் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a turning
entries.english: From an apparently primary word τρέπω trepō (to turn); a turn (“trope”), that is, revolution (figuratively variation): - turning.

entries.tamil:
சேர்த்துக் கொள்ளும் வண்ணம், அப்படியே, பிரகாரம் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a manner, way, fashion
2. manner of life, character
entries.english: From the same as G5157; a turn, that is, (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relatively prefixed as adverb like); figuratively deportment or character: - (even) as, conversation, [+ like] manner (+ by any) means, way.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஆதரி

to bear one's manners, endure our's character
entries.english: From G5158 and G5409; to endure one’s habits: - suffer the manners.

entries.tamil:
ஆகாரம், போஜனம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

food, nourishment
entries.english: From G5142; nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication rations (wages): - food, meat.

entries.tamil:
துரோப்பீம் - ஒர் ஆணின் பெயர்

Trophimus

entries.english: A primary preposition; “over”, that is, (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than. In compounds it retains many of the listed applications: - (+ exceeding abundantly) above, in (on) behalf of, beyond, by, + very chiefest, concerning, exceeding (above, -ly), for, + very highly, more (than), of, over, on the part of, for sake of, in stead, than, to (-ward), very. In compounds it retains many of the above applications.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உயர்த்து

exalt self, be exalted above measure, to become haughty

entries.tamil:
கடந்துபோன - பெயரடை

2. overripe, plump and ripe
entries.english: From G5228 and the base of G188; beyond the “acme”, that is, figuratively (of a daughter) past the bloom (prime) of youth: - + pass the flower of (her) age.

entries.tamil:
மேலாய் - வினையடை

above
entries.english: From G5228 and G507; above upward, that is, greatly higher (in place or rank): - far above, over.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மிகவும் பெருகு

to increase beyond measure; to grow exceedingly
entries.english: From G5228 and G837; to increase above ordinary degree: - grow exceedingly.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மீறு

to step over, go beyond
entries.english: From G5228 and the base of G939; to transcend; that is, (figuratively) to overreach: - go beyond.

entries.tamil:
அதிகமாய் - வினையடை

above measure
entries.english: Adverb from present participle active of G5235; excessively: - beyond measure.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - அதிகமாயிரு, மிகவும், மகா, வல்லவராயிரு

1. to surpass in throwing; to throw over or beyond anything

entries.english: From G5228 and G906; to throw beyond the usual mark, that is, (figuratively) to surpass (only active participle supereminent): - exceeding, excel, pass.

entries.tamil:

2. superiority, excellence, preeminence
entries.english: From G5235; a throwing beyond others, that is, (figuratively) supereminence; adverbially (with G1519 or G2596) pre-eminently: - abundance, (far more) exceeding, excellency, more excellent, beyond (out of) measure.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - காண்

to overlook
entries.english: From G5228 and G1492; to overlook, that is, not punish: - wink at.

entries.tamil:
அப்புறமாய் - வினையடை

beyond
entries.english: From G5228 and the neuter plural of G1565; above those parts, that is, still farther: - beyond.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மிஞ்சிப்போ

to extend beyond the prescribed bounds, stretch out beyond measure, stretch out overmuch
entries.english: From G5228 and G1614; to extend inordinately: - stretch beyond.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சரிந்துவிழு

to pour out beyond measure; passive, to overflow, run over
entries.english: From G5228 and the alternate form of G1632; to pour out over, that is, (passively) to overflow: - run over.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - வேண்டுதல் செய்

to intercede for one
entries.english: From G5228 and G1793; to intercede in behalf of: - make intercession for.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மேலாயிரு, மேன்மையாயிரு

1. to have or hold over one
2. to stand out, rise above, overtop
entries.english: From G5228 and G2192; to hold oneself above, that is, (figuratively) to excel; participle (as adjective, or neuter as noun) superior, superiority: - better, excellency, higher, pass, supreme.

entries.tamil:
பெருமை - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

pride, haughtiness, arrogance
entries.english: From G5244; haughtiness: - pride.

entries.tamil:
அகந்தையுள்ள,பெருமையுள்ள - பெயரடை

2. with an overweening estimate of one's means or merits, despising others or even treating them with contempt, haughty
entries.english: From G5228 and G5316; appearing above others (conspicuous), that is, (figuratively) haughty: - proud.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஜெயங்கொள்

to be more than a conqueror, to gain a surpassing victory
entries.english: From G5228 and G3528; to vanquish beyond, that is, gain a decisive victory: - more than conquer.

entries.tamil:
வீண் வார்த்தைகளான - பெயரடை

overswollen; immoderate, extravagant
entries.english: From G5228 and G3591; bulging over, that is, (figuratively) insolent: - great swelling.

entries.tamil:
சிறந்தது, அதிகாரம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

elevation, pre - eminence, superiority
entries.english: From G5242; prominence, that is, (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character): - authority, excellency.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - அதிகமாய்ப் பெருகு, பரிபூரணமாயிரு

to abound beyond measure, abound exceedingly
entries.english: From G5228 and G4052; to super abound: - abound much more, exceeding.

entries.tamil:
மேன்மேலும் - வினையடை

beyond measure, exceedingly
entries.english: From G5228 and G4057; superabundantly, that is, exceedingly: - beyond measure.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - பரிபூரணமாய்ப் பெருகு

to be exceedingly abundant
entries.english: From G5228 and G4121; to super abound: - be exceeding abundant.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மேலாக உயர்த்து

2. to extol most highly
3. to be lifted up with pride, exalted beyond measure; to carry oneself loftily
entries.english: From G5228 and G5312; to elevate above others, that is, raise to the highest position: - highly exalt.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மிஞ்சி எண்ணு

to think more highly of oneself than is proper
entries.english: From G5228 and G5426; to esteem oneself overmuch, that is, be vain or arrogant: - think more highly.

entries.tamil:
மேல்வீடு - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

the highest part of the house, the upper rooms or story where the women resided
entries.english: Neuter of a derivative of G5228; a higher part of the house, that is, apartment in the third story: - upper chamber (room).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - அனுபவி

to hold under, to put under, place underneath
entries.english: From G5259 and G2192; to hold oneself under, that is, endure with patience: - suffer.

entries.tamil:
கீழ்ப்படிந்த - பெயரடை

giving ear, obedient
entries.english: From G5219; attentively listening, that is, (by implication) submissive: - obedient.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஊழியஞ்செய், வேலைசெய்

1. to act as rower, to row
2. to minister, render service
entries.english: From G5257; to be a subordinate, that is, (by implication) subserve: - minister (unto), serve.

entries.tamil:
சேவகன், வேலைக்காரன், பணிவிடைக்காரன், ஊழியக்காரர், உதவிக்காரர் - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. an under rower, subordinate rower
2. a servant
3. an assistant
entries.english: From G5259 and a derivative of ἐρέσσω eressō (to row); an under oarsman, that is, (genitive case) subordinate (assistant, sexton, constable): - minister, officer, servant.

entries.tamil:
நித்திரை - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

sleep
entries.english: From an obsolete primary (perhaps akin to G5259 through the idea of subsilience); sleep, that is, (figuratively) spiritual torpor: - sleep.

entries.tamil:
ஆல், இல் - முன்னிடைச்சொல்

under
entries.english: A primary preposition; under, that is, (with the genitive) of place (beneath), or with verbs (the agency or means, through); (with the accusative) of place (whither [underneath] or where [below]) or time (when [at]): - among, by, from, in, of, under, with. In compounds it retains the same genitive applications, especially of inferior position or condition, and specifically covertly or moderately.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஏற்படுத்து

1. to throw or put under
2. to suggest to the mind
3. to instruct privately, instigate, suborn: tina

entries.tamil:
மாதிரி - ஆண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a writing - copy
2. an example set before one
entries.english: From a compound of G5259 and G1125; an underwriting, that is, copy for imitation (figuratively): - example.

entries.tamil:
மாதிரி, திருஷ்டாந்தம், சாயல் - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a sign suggestive of anything, delineation of a thing, representation, figure, copy
2. an example
entries.english: From G5263; an exhibit for imitation or warning (figuratively specimen, adumbration): - en- (ex-) ample, pattern.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - வகைகாட்டு, காண்பி

1. to show by placing under (before) the eyes
2. to show by words and arguments, to teach
entries.english: From G5259 and G1166; to exhibit under the eyes, (figuratively) to exemplify (instruct, admonish): - show, (fore-) warn.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஏற்றுக்கொள்

to receive as a guest
entries.english: From G5259 and G1209; to admit under one’s roof, that is, entertain hospitably: - receive.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - போட்டுக்கொாள், தொடுத்துக்கொள்

to trader - bind
entries.english: From G5259 and G1210; to bind under one’s feet, that is, put on shoes or sandals: - bind on, (be) shod.

entries.tamil:
பாதரட்சை - பால் வேறுபாடற்ற பெயர்ச்சொல்

what is bound under, a sandal, a sole fastened to the foot with thongs
entries.english: From G5265; something bound under the feet, that is, a shoe or sandal: - shoe.

entries.tamil:
குற்றமுள்ள - பெயரடை

entries.english: From G5259 and G1349; under sentence, that is, (by implication) condemned: - guilty.

entries.english: Neuter of a compound of G5259 and G2218; an animal under the yoke (draught beast), that is, (specifically) a donkey: - ass.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - சுற்றிக் கட்டு

to under - gird
entries.english: From G5259 and G2224; to gird under, that is, frap (a vessel with cables across the keel, sides and deck): - undergirt.

entries.english: From G5259 and G2736; down under, that is, beneath: - under.

வினைச்சொல் - மீதியாயிரு

entries.english: From G5278; cheerful (or hopeful) endurance, constancy: - enduring, patience, patient continuance (waiting).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - நினை, எண்ணு

to suppose, surmise
entries.english: From G5259 and G3539; to think under (privately), that is, to surmise or conjecture: - think, suppose, deem.

entries.tamil:
சம்சயம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a surmising
entries.english: From G5282; suspicion: - surmising.

to sail under, to sail close by, pass to the leeward of

வினைச்சொல் - மெதுவாயடி

breeze, blow softly, to breath gently
entries.english: From G5259 and G4154; to breathe gently, that is, breeze: - blow softly.

a footstool
entries.english: Neuter of a compound of G5259 and G4228; something under the feet, that is, a footrest (figuratively): - footstool.

entries.tamil:
நிச்சயம், தைரியம், தன்மை, நம்பிக்கை - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. a setting or placing under; thing put under, substructure, foundation

entries.english: From a compound of G5259 and G2476; a setting under (support), that is, (figuratively) concretely essence, or abstractly assurance (objectively or subjectively): - confidence, confident, person, substance.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - மறைத்துவை, நீங்கு, விலகிப்பிரி, பின்வாங்கு

2. to withdraw oneself, to be timid, to cower, shrink
entries.english: From G5259 and G4724; to withhold under (out of sight), that is, (reflexively) to cower or shrink, (figuratively) to conceal (reserve): - draw (keep) back, shun, withdraw.

entries.tamil:
பின்வாங்குதல் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

a withdrawing
entries.english: From G5288; shrinkage (timidity), that is, (by implication) apostasy: - draw back.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - திரும்பிவா, திரும்பிப்போ, முறியடித்துவா

1. to turn back, to turn about
2. to turn back, to return
entries.english: From G5259 and G4762; to turn under (behind), that is, to return (literally or figuratively): - come again, return (again, back again), turn back (again).

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - விரி

to strew; spread under
entries.english: From G5259 and G4766; to strew underneath (the feet as a carpet): - spread.

entries.tamil:
கீழ்ப்படிதல், அடக்கம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. the act of subjecting
2. obedience, subjection
entries.english: From G5293; subordination: - subjection.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - உபதேசி

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - ஒதுக்கத்திலே ஒடு

to run under
entries.english: From G5259 and G5143 (including its alternate); to run under, that is, (specifically) to sail past: - run under.

entries.tamil:
திருஷ்டாந்தம் - பெண்பால் பெயர்ச்சொல்

1. an outline, sketch, brief and summary exposition
2. an example, pattern
entries.english: From a compound of G5259 and a derivative of G5179; typification under (after), that is, (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation: - form, pattern.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - தாங்கு, சகி

to bear by being under, bear up
entries.english: From G5259 and G5342; to bear from underneath, that is, (figuratively) to undergo hardship: - bear, endure.

entries.tamil:
வினைச்சொல் - தனித்துப்போ, போ

to go back to withdraw
entries.english: From G5259 and G5562; to vacate down, that is, retire quietly: - go aside, withdraw self.

வினைச்சொல் - அலட்டு, கீழ்ப்படுத்து

2. a blow in that part of the face; a black and blue spot, a bruise, to keep down, keep in subjection
entries.english: From a compound of G5259 and a derivative of G3700; to hit under the eye (buffet or disable an antagonist as a pugilist), that is, (figuratively) to tease or annoy (into compliance), subdue (one’s passions): - keep under, weary.
